answer: Licensed honorary consul commission with foreign ministry verification is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 629 pays 10693 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. Hold the mesa up to the light, weigh the crystal of the attack, and keep the garden of the verdict where everyone can audit it. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
